Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses and Aaron, speaking to them.
translations.2: Speak to the sons of Israel, and say to them: any man who has a discharge from his member — his discharge is impure.
translations.3: And this is the description of his discharge by which his impurity occurs: whether his member lets the discharge flow like a coin, or it becomes sealed from it — that is his impurity.
translations.4: And his ruling is that every bed upon which he lies shall become impure, and every vessel upon which he sits shall become impure.
translations.5: And any person who approaches his bed shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be impure until sunset.
translations.6: And whoever sits upon the vessel upon which the one with a discharge sits shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be impure until sunset.
translations.7: And whoever approaches him bodily shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be impure until sunset.
translations.8: And if the one with a discharge spits upon the pure person, he shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be impure until sunset.
translations.10: And whoever approaches anything that was beneath him shall be made impure until sunset; and whoever carries any of those things shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be impure until sunset.
translations.11: And everyone whom the one with a discharge approaches, he himself not having washed in water, shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be made impure until sunset.
translations.12: And any earthenware vessel which the one with a discharge approaches shall be broken; and any wooden vessel shall be washed in water.
translations.13: And when he is purified from his discharge, he shall count off seven days for his purification and wash his garments, and bathe his body in water from a spring, and he shall be pure.
translations.14: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and come before God to the entrance of the tent of the assembly, and deliver them to the priest.
translations.15: And the priest shall make one of them a purification-offering and the other a burnt-offering, and shall seek forgiveness for him before God on account of his discharge.
translations.16: And any man from whom a drop of seed of propagation goes forth shall wash all his body in water, and be impure until sunset.
translations.17: And any garment or skin upon which anything from it has fallen shall be washed in water, and be impure until sunset.
translations.18: And any woman with whom a man lies with a drop of seed — both of them shall bathe in water, and be made impure until sunset.
translations.19: Any woman who has a discharge — that is, when blood flows from her opening — she shall remain seven days in her menstrual period; and everyone who approaches her shall be made impure until sunset.
translations.20: And everything upon which she lies during her menstrual period shall become impure, and every vessel upon which she sits shall become impure.
translations.21: And everyone who approaches her bed shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be impure until sunset.
translations.22: And everyone who approaches anything from the vessels upon which she sits shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be impure until sunset.
translations.23: And if there is contact with it — whether upon her bed or upon the vessel upon which she is sitting — he shall be impure until sunset.
translations.24: And if a man lies with her, then the ruling of her menstrual period comes upon him, and he shall be impure seven days; and every bed upon which he lies shall become impure.
translations.25: And any woman whose blood flows for many days outside the time of her menstrual period, or following upon it — all the days of the flow of her impurity she shall be in it as in the days of her menstrual period: impure.
translations.26: And every bed upon which she lies throughout the days of her flow shall be to her as her bed during her menstrual period; and every vessel upon which she sits shall be impure, as its impurity during her menstrual period.
translations.27: And everyone who approaches anything of hers shall become impure; and he shall wash his garments, and bathe in water, and be impure until sunset.
translations.28: But if she is purified from her flow, she shall count off seven days, and after that she shall be pure.
translations.29: And on the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of the assembly.
translations.30: And the priest shall make one of them a purification-offering and the other a burnt-offering, and shall seek forgiveness for her before God on account of the flow of her impurity.
translations.31: It is therefore required that the sons of Israel be kept apart from their impurity, so that they do not perish through their impurity — for they would defile My dwelling that is among them.
translations.32: This is the ordinance of the one with a discharge, and of him from whom a drop of seed goes forth, causing impurity.
translations.33: And of the menstruating woman in her menstruation, and of the one with a flow in his discharge — male and female — and of a man who lies with an impure woman.
